## Checks and review gaps

Mark only completed checks; explain anything pending or not applicable.

- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/chaotic-mixture/materials-boundaries-public/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and kept the change focused.
- [ ] Theoretical bounds, model relations, observations, computational predictions and synthetic demos remain distinct; units, conditions, domains and uncertainty are explicit. Unknown is not unbounded.
- [ ] Source URLs and page/equation/table/passage locators identify what was actually inspected; original derivations, uninspected gaps and pending scientific/translation review are disclosed.
- [ ] Source-specific rights and attribution are recorded without blanket third-party relicensing. No copyrighted PDFs, source images/full text, excluded NIST coefficients/derived outputs, credentials, private data or personal data are included.
- [ ] Relevant stable IDs, four-language labels and nonexecution boundaries are preserved; any new scientific contract is identified for separate review.
- [ ] I report commands and actual results below, including failures and unrun checks. Software validation does not establish scientific truth, independent review or reuse rights.
